guide.blockbill.title: BlockBill — player guide
guide.blockbill.start.title: Survive. Earn. Subscribe.
guide.blockbill.start.body:
Your goal is still to defeat the Ender Dragon. BlockBill sells 9 everyday comforts for in-game credits. No real money!

Your first 5 minutes of Survival include all services. Collect resources, trade them for credits, then choose services, bundles or Plus, Pro and Business plans.

Start with /blockbill services and /blockbill status. Open chat with T or / to enter commands.
guide.blockbill.services.title: Mining, sleeping and sprinting
guide.blockbill.services.body:
Buying an individual service adds about 10 minutes of Survival play.

Mine+ — 20 credits. Without it, mining below Y40 causes Mining Fatigue I.
Sleep+ — 15 credits. Required to sleep and skip the night.
Sprint+ — 15 credits. Without it, sprinting for 6 seconds causes Slowness I for 4 seconds, at most once every 8 seconds.

Purchase: /blockbill buy mine, sleep or sprint. The basic bundle extends all three for 40 credits.
guide.blockbill.exchange.title: Turn resources into credits
guide.blockbill.exchange.body:
One bundle → credits:
logs: 16 logs → 12
cobblestone: 32 cobblestone → 16
rotten_flesh: 8 rotten flesh → 12
iron_ingot: 4 iron ingots → 36
coal: 8 coal → 16
wheat: 16 wheat → 12
copper_ingot: 8 copper ingots → 16
redstone: 16 redstone → 20
gold_ingot: 4 gold ingots → 32
emerald: 1 emerald → 28

/blockbill exchange logs 2: 32 logs earn 24 credits. Mine+ costs 20, leaving 4. Only items in your inventory count; incomplete bundles are not taken.
guide.blockbill.commands.title: Commands for every situation
guide.blockbill.commands.body:
/blockbill help — quick help
/blockbill services — 9 services and rules
/blockbill plans — Plus / Pro / Business
/blockbill status — expiry and auto-renewal
/blockbill prices — all prices and exchanges

/blockbill exchange logs 2 — trade 32 logs
/blockbill buy mine — Mine+ for 10 minutes
/blockbill buy workshop — workshop bundle
/blockbill buy pro — all services for 30 min
/blockbill autorenew mine on — enable
/blockbill autorenew mine off — disable

Exact commands appear in services and plans.
guide.blockbill.time.title: You only pay for play time
guide.blockbill.time.body:
Time runs only while you are online in Survival. Leaving the world or pausing single-player stops the clock and auto-renewal. Multiplayer keeps running while you read this guide.

The trial lasts about 5 minutes. Services and ordinary bundles add 10 minutes; Plus adds 15, Pro 30, Business 60. Server lag makes these periods longer.

Each service has its own expiry. Buying early preserves all remaining time. Check expiry and auto-renewal with /blockbill status.
guide.blockbill.safety.title: Your progress stays yours
guide.blockbill.safety.body:
Credits, subscription time and auto-renewal settings survive death, reconnects and world restarts. Every player has a separate account. Restrictions apply only in Survival.

After payment, existing mining fatigue fades within 3 seconds; a sprint penalty within 4. Other potion effects are not removed.

Ordinary chests, barrels, crafting tables, furnaces, movement, combat and portals remain free. Paid windows already open stay open.

Upgrading from 0.1 or 0.2 preserves your account and paid periods. Auto-renewal settings from 0.2 stay unchanged. The trial does not restart.

guide.blockbill.workshop.title: The workshop
guide.blockbill.workshop.body:
Enchant+ — 25 credits. Required to open an enchanting table. Command: /blockbill buy enchant

Anvil+ — 20 credits. Required to open any anvil. Command: /blockbill buy anvil

Smith+ — 20 credits. Required to open a smithing table. Command: /blockbill buy smith

The workshop bundle extends all three for 50 credits. Crafting tables and furnaces remain free.
guide.blockbill.trade.title: Trading with villagers
guide.blockbill.trade.body:
Trade+ — 20 credits for 10 minutes. Purchase: /blockbill buy trade

Required to start trading with an adult villager or wandering trader. A trade window already open is not closed when access expires.

Feeding and curing other mobs do not require Trade+. Selling resources to BlockBill itself also stays free.
guide.blockbill.fishing.title: Fishing
guide.blockbill.fishing.body:
Fish+ — 15 credits for 10 minutes. Purchase: /blockbill buy fish

Required to cast a fishing rod. If access expires after casting, you can still reel in the existing line.

Fish+ is included in explorer: Mine+, Sprint+, Fish+ and Storage+ for 50 credits.
guide.blockbill.storage.title: Storing your items
guide.blockbill.storage.body:
Storage+ — 15 credits for 10 minutes. Purchase: /blockbill buy storage

Required to open an ender chest or shulker box. Ordinary chests and barrels are free.

Expiry does not close an open window or confiscate items. Breaking and collecting containers follows normal Minecraft rules.

Sneaking to place a block beside a paid workstation remains available.
guide.blockbill.bundles.title: Four service bundles
guide.blockbill.bundles.body:
/blockbill buy basic — 40 credits: Mine+, Sleep+, Sprint+.

/blockbill buy workshop — 50: Enchant+, Anvil+, Smith+.

/blockbill buy explorer — 50: Mine+, Sprint+, Fish+, Storage+.

/blockbill buy all — 120: all 9 services.

A bundle adds 10 minutes to each included service. If you cannot afford it, nothing changes. Bundles are never purchased automatically.
guide.blockbill.autorenew.title: Optional auto-renewal
guide.blockbill.autorenew.body:
Disabled by default for every service. Example: /blockbill autorenew mine on. To disable: /blockbill autorenew mine off.

When access expires, one 10-minute period is bought at that service's individual price. No charges during the trial. Whole bundles and plans never auto-renew. Buying Plus, Pro or Business keeps your existing settings.

If credits are insufficient or the duration cannot be extended, auto-renewal is disabled with a message. No retries until you enable it again.

Simultaneous expiries are processed in this order: mine, sleep, sprint, enchant, anvil, smith, trade, fish, storage. Settings appear in status.

blockbill.rule.sleep: Without access, sleeping and skipping the night are unavailable.
blockbill.rule.sprint: Without access, 6 seconds of sprinting causes 4 seconds of slowness.
blockbill.rule.enchant: Required to open an enchanting table.
blockbill.rule.smith: Required to open a smithing table.
blockbill.rule.trade: Required to start trading with an adult villager or wandering trader.
blockbill.rule.fish: Required to cast a fishing rod; an existing line can still be reeled in.
blockbill.rule.storage: Required to open ender chests and shulker boxes; ordinary chests and barrels are free.

guide.blockbill.plans.title: Plus / Pro / Business plans
guide.blockbill.plans.body:
Plus — 90 credits: 15 minutes for each of 5 services — Mine+, Sleep+, Sprint+, Fish+, Storage+.
/blockbill buy plus

Pro — 300 credits: 30 minutes for all 9 services.
/blockbill buy pro

Business — 540 credits: 60 minutes for all 9 services.
/blockbill buy business

Every plan applies only to its buyer. Business does not pay for other players.

Time is added to each service separately, preserving what remains. Plus after Pro never shortens a period: five services gain 15 minutes, and the others keep their time. Check status for expiry.

A plan never enables or disables auto-renewal. It remains individual in 10-minute periods. Compare: /blockbill plans.
